suku.consejo: Community that shares origin, culture or history.

adat.consejo: Practice or rule that is part of a tradition.

kulit.consejo: Outer layer of a body or leather material.

tanaman.consejo: Being alive that grows on earth and does not move.

penutup kepala.es: tocado; prenda para cubrir la cabeza
penutup kepala.consejo: Light or piece that covers the head.

hiasan.consejo: Object that embellishes a garment or place.

bulu.consejo: Fine hair or feathers that cover certain animals.

manik-manik.consejo: Small balls that are used as a ornament.

setagen.consejo: Long band of fabric that rolls around the waist.

kalung.consejo: The ornament is carried around the neck.

gelang.consejo: The ornament is carried on the wrist or arm.

akar.consejo: Part of a plant that grows under the earth.

berbahan.consejo: Form ber- which indicates the material of an object.

terdiri atas.consejo: Expression to list the parts of something.

bawahan.consejo: Clothes that cover the bottom of the body.

texto: **Berbahan kulit tanaman** means «made from plant skin». **Berbahan** describes the material from which an object is made.
**Penutup kepala** is a garment that covers the head; **hiasan** is an ornament. The meaning of the clothes varies according to the group and context.
